history.description: Incremental update workflow, transactional package engine, strict sequence state, tests, and the authoritative 0.19.4 roadmap.
Module schema, configuration, generated registry, classic-script loader, four existing workspace manifests, registry-driven launcher, offline shell integration, tests, and architecture documentation.

Shared application-shell foundation with central design tokens, component primitives, interface-region discovery, panel controller, command registry, compatibility bootstrap, offline caching, tests, and architecture documentation.

Shared visual harmonization for Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, and PDF; content-first default panel states; session-only panel preference persistence; and centered PDF open-document empty state.

PDF shell stabilization: deterministic closed-by-default navigation panel, session-only preference, accessible toggle state, zero-width collapsed layout, unified red PDF identity across launcher and viewer, regression tests, and revised ordered roadmap.

PDF selected-text review: highlight, underline, and comment commands derived from PDF.js text-layer selection; multi-line and multi-page page-relative geometry; linked undo groups; free marker/text isolation; persistence compatibility; tests and documentation.

Documents active-page ruler: rendered page width and position tracking, zoom and horizontal-scroll synchronization, section-aware page dimensions, explicit margin zones, generated ruler ticks and numbers, dynamic paragraph-indent pointer mapping, tests and documentation.

Spreadsheet formula-reference selection module: preserve the formula target cell while selecting source cells, drag ranges, Ctrl/Command discontinuous references, touch Add Range fallback, live formula-bar insertion and visual reference outlines, without rewriting the spreadsheet editor.

Spreadsheet formula-authoring polish: in-cell formula editor, larger uncluttered formula bar, cell-reference-aware suggestions, Tab/pointer suggestion acceptance, Enter-only confirmation, parenthesis balancing on commit, and integration with drag and discontinuous reference selection.

Persistent spreadsheet formula sessions in normal-size cells, drafts that survive cell changes, two-letter non-blocking suggestions, successive-click and drag references, postfix percentage semantics, and improved GitHub Actions failure/rollback diagnostics.

InkDesk visual foundation: Apple-like native system typography, uniform rounded controls and start actions, tactile selected/pressed states, raised three-dimensional retractable panels, a minimal quill and inkwell suite identity, redesigned Documents/Spreadsheets/Presentations/PDF icons, and planned EPUB/TXT symbols.

PDF unified Save after the visual foundation: one rounded Save command, removal of parallel export/import/original/print actions, PDF.js structure-preserving save when no InkDesk review exists, page-by-page flattened annotated export when review marks exist, offline caching, stable inherited tests, and documentation.

Quieter launcher, visual action alignment, shared unsaved-change protection, and non-invasive editable filenames. Complete application files are preserved; title editing and download-name rewriting are implemented by the shared document-session adapter.

Modular local Plain Text workspace with New, Open, Save, editable filename, UTF-8 and UTF-16 opening, preserved line endings, Find, word wrap, text size, undo/redo, live counts, unsaved-change protection, universal TXT routing, launcher integration, tests, documentation, and offline caching.
